items.title: Fix dead-value machinabilityScale dropped from UltimateSpeedFeed Vc
items.why: aluminum machinability=2.5 never speeds the recommendation.
items.evidence: NOT-A-BUG (verified 2026-07-05): machinabilityScale at UltimateSpeedFeedEngine.ts:2343 is CORRECTLY dead. baseParams=CUTTING_PARAMS[dataKey] (:2283) is ISO-GROUP-specific, so baseVc already encodes the group machinability (baseVc[N] is aluminum-fast). machinabilityScale = mat.machinability_factor/steel (aluminum ~2.5x). Multiplying them into Vc (:2346) would DOUBLE-COUNT -> ~2.5x OVER-SPEED on aluminum. The synthesis romeo-1 P4 mis-classified this; applying the fix is a dangerous over-speed regression. Leave the value dropped (or delete the unused computation as cleanup, no Vc change).

Each boundary = 2-arm + safety-physics.
